gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro opens its letters wide and welcoming, with a gentle, level stroke. Beneath the nearly sealed urban letters of Capture It, pages of text would glide by smoothly, line after line, without a snag.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, with curves that leave daylight inside. But Capture It draws urban, commanding ballpoint-pen strokes, and that tight-versus-spacious clash is the best thing here.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-miriam-libre: Nearly sealed letters give Capture It its urban, commanding look, while Miriam Libre keeps its s generously open between the bends. Text in it moves along like fine wire, light and easy.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Capture It arrives blunt and urban, its letters nearly sealed shut. Mochiy Pop One then supplies the big, open lowercase eyes, so the heading's closed-in force has something spacious to rest against.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-montserrat-unde: Capture It hits hard, urban and commanding, with barely a gap. Montserrat Underline brings sans-serif lines with round, breathing counters, so pages of it would flow along without any fuss.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mozilla-text: Capture It lays down urban, commanding letters whose joins stay full where strokes meet. Yet Mozilla Text sits beside it with flared terminals and an open feel, loosening the page without softening the punch.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-nata-sans: Closed, nearly sealed letters with no stroke modulation make Capture It hit with urban, commanding force. Nata Sans does the opposite job, with wide, unclosed curves and a steady technical-pen line built for the text itself.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-nokora: Urban and commanding, Capture It keeps its letters nearly sealed, while Nokora opens a wide s that never tightens. That dark stripe of lowercase holds its own against the heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-kufi-arabi: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with a welcoming gap in the c, capitals barely above lowercase. And since Capture It has no stroke modulation at all, pages beneath it would move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans: Contemporary Noto Sans fills most of its letter height with lowercase body, leaving the c wide open. But Capture It is best at a blunt urban shout, where the body face is best at staying open.
